archetype: Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy combined with Professional High-Contrast

headings.instruction: DO NOT use Inter or standard fonts for headings. Use Outfit with tracking-tight (-0.02em to -0.04em) for all H1-H3. Use fluid scaling but NEVER exceed text-6xl for Hero H1.

body.instruction: Use Manrope for all body text, dashboard data, and labels. Maintain high contrast (text-slate-900).

monospaced.instruction: Use strictly for audit logs, numeric data in tables, or transaction IDs.

background.instruction: Marketing pages should feel grounded and warm (FDFBF7). Dashboard should be crisp and functional (F8FAFC).

primary.instruction: Deep Crimson. Use strictly for primary CTAs like 'Apply Now' and major progressive actions.

secondary.instruction: Empowerment Gold. Use for secondary highlights, warning states, and status indicators.

text.heading: #0F172A
text.instruction: Never use pure black or gray. Always tint with blue (slate series).

marketing.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, p-24.
marketing.grid: MODE A: The 'Tetris' Grid (Bento style). Use gap-8 or gap-12. Avoid symmetric two-column standard layouts. Use col-span-8 and col-span-4 to create tension.
marketing.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80, 1px bottom border-slate-200. Must have 'Apply Now' and 'Member Login' buttons.

dashboard.spacing: Dense and compact. Use p-4 to p-6 inside cards.
dashboard.grid: MODE B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6. Left-sidebar for navigation.
dashboard.cards: Cardless or Flat style. bg-white, 1px border-slate-200. NO default soft shadows. Add subtle translate-y-1 and shadow-md ONLY on hover for interactive cards.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px solid borders for definition. No muddy drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a very subtle noise/grain overlay (opacity 2-3%) to the marketing hero section to break digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.overlays: Hero images must use bg-black/30 or a gradient overlay for text legibility. NEVER blanket opacity that hides the image.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: All interactive elements MUST explicitly define a lighter hover color AND a text color. Example: hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white

motion.marketing: Use framer-motion for staggered entrance of Bento grid items. Implement 'lenis' for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion.dashboard: Minimalist motion. Limit to micro-interactions (button presses, dropdowns). No heavy page transitions.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for Marketing, slightly rounded (rounded-md) for Dashboard. Always include transition-colors duration-200.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form components. Inputs must have clear focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/50).
components.charts: Use Recharts inside Shadcn Chart wrappers. Color palette for charts: #9F1239, #D97706, #0F172A, #94A3B8.
components.tables: Use Shadcn Table. Zebra striping or clear border-b for rows. Left-align data, right-align numbers.
components.toasts: Use Sonner for all notifications, especially post-form submissions (Applications, Member Profile updates).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Use Text-Shadow if placing text over images.
accessibility.testing: CRITICAL: Add data-testid attributes to ALL interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='apply-now-btn', data-testid='login-submit').

hero_image.description: Woman sitting in the driver's seat of a red truck - Use for main Marketing Hero background.

feature_image_1.description: Woman in white truck driver seat - Use for Ambassador Spotlight or About section.

feature_image_2.description: Group stacking hands - Use for Community Impact / Volunteering section.

abstract_logo.description: Abstract colorful shapes (slack-like) - Use as a placeholder for the AAWTA logo in the header and sidebar if needed.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts: Outfit and Manrope via Google Fonts in index.css.
Install UI primitives: use Shadcn for all interactive elements (dialogs, select, tables, forms).
Build the marketing site (Home, About, Volunteer, Apply) in the public routes.
Build the dashboard (Admin, Ambassador, Volunteer roles) in private/protected routes.
DO NOT use generic centered text blocks. Use asymmetrical left-aligned blocks with negative space.
Ensure Header has the required contact info (Power Lab address, Phone: 770 756 6768) and a link to www.aawta.org.
For the Ambassador Directory, use a dense grid of cards with member profile details.
For the Dashboard, include dummy data and use Recharts for the Monthly Goals Tracker.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡.
